honestGap.what: Real inbox receipt of a Resend-sent email has still not been independently verified by this agent. Provider acceptance and the full technical confirm/login/upload/download chain ARE verified with real evidence above. The distinction matters: an email can be accepted by Resend and never verified as actually landing in an inbox from this agent's side.
honestGap.why: The Gmail MCP connector available in this environment requires interactive re-authentication (/mcp) that only the owner can perform in their own terminal.
honestGap.resolution_needed: Owner should either run /mcp to re-authenticate Gmail, or manually check an inbox for a Resend-sent Hasheem Studio confirmation email and report back.

minorDisclosure.what: A short-lived test-account session JWT (access_token, 1-hour expiry) appeared in this session's tool output as part of Playwright's page.url() capture during the confirmation-link click-through test.
minorDisclosure.severity: Low — this is a per-session, short-expiry auth token for a disposable test account created and destroyed within this same session, not a static provider credential. It is a materially different and lower-severity category than the RESEND_API_KEY/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN exposure from the prior session.
minorDisclosure.mitigation: The underlying test account (id cf0d3109-a039-419c-a545-533be181cbd4) was deleted via the admin API immediately after the test, real 200 confirmed — the token now references a nonexistent user.
